review_candidates.description_excerpt: ICE Endpoint Solutions is responsible for every endpoint, physical and virtual, globally, which currently accounts for 20,000 devices. Endpoint Solutions - Engineering implements and improves the technologies used to manage, maintain, secure, and ensure compliance across ICE’s global physical and virtual endpoint estate. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Knowledge And Experience Virtualization / Horizon Infrastructure - Strong experience designing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise VDI environments, with hands-on familiarity with VMware Horizon / Omnissa Horizon. Workstation OS - 5+ years of experience managing and optimizing Windows 11 in both physical and virtualized environments. Desktop Management Systems - 5+ years of experience building and managing desktop infrastructure using tools such as Broadcom Altiris, Microsoft SCCM, Intune, or Tanium.
